hooks.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$1" == *.py ]]; then echo "Running ruff on Python file: $1"; ruff check --fix "$1" && ruff format "$1"; fi'
bash -c 'if [[ "$1" == bin/* ]] && [[ "$1" != *.sh ]]; then echo "Running ruff on bin script: $1"; ruff check --fix "$1" && ruff format "$1"; fi'
bash -c 'if [[ "$1" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$ ]]; then echo "Running ESLint on JS/TS file: $1"; npm run lint -- --fix "$1" && npx jest --findRelatedTests "$1"; fi'

bash -c 'if command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f .pre-commit-config.yaml ]; then echo "Fixing whitespace in: $1"; pre-commit run trailing-whitespace --files "$1" 2>/dev/null || true; pre-commit run end-of-file-fixer --files "$1" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$1" | grep -iE "(commit|push|pr|pull request)" > /dev/null; then echo "🔍 Detected commit intent. Will run pre-commit checks..."; if ! curl -s http://localhost:5328/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "⚠️ WARNING: Flask not running! Integration tests will fail. Start with: npm run flask-dev"; fi; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$1" | grep -iE "ready.*commit|commit.*ready|finished.*changes" > /dev/null; then echo "📋 Running full test suite..."; pytest tests/ && pytest integration_tests/ && npm test && npm run lint && npm run type-check && ruff check . && echo "✅ All pre-commit checks passed!"; fi'
